note: Reservoir SRA 9 mi N of Hemingford (1,600-acre lake), on a paved road. The campground is newer (opened about 2023): an Electric Plus loop and a row of pull-throughs on the bank above the north shore, and basic sites strung along the shore road to the boat ramp. In the off season the sites are first-come only. --Claude
